The absence of motor weakness, sensory deficits, and preserved deep tendon reflexes (ankle and knee) indicates *non-compressive* or *mildly compressive* pathology — i.e., no significant neurologic deficit, consistent with early or partial radicular irritation rather than severe nerve compromise.
